purpose: Second-chain replication of the H3 control design on qubits disjoint from chain A and its neighbours
design: ibm_marrakesh, chain [9, 8, 7, 6, 5, 4] chosen by lowest summed readout error excluding chain A [55, 54, 53, 39, 33, 32] and its neighbours; model frozen from calibration H1-B (job db554vclf4us73c3i8ag); 4 randomized blocks x 6000 shots; block-order seed 20261014

arms.gp_dd: GP schedule from the chain-B model (36 pulses; 4 on logical qubit 1 = physical 8)
arms.gp_dd_protect_q54: label kept from H3; here protects logical qubit 1 (physical 8) with 8 pulses (40)

primary: gp_dd minus cpmg8_uniform, P(all six qubits return to 0), shot-only 95% CI
analysis_script: benchmarks/analyze_ibm_h3.py with tag b (logic identical to the hashed H3 script; see h3_script_note.txt)
pooling: Fixed-effect inverse-variance pooling of the chain-A and chain-B primary differences, reported alongside each chain
stopping_rule: Single run on chain B; no conditional follow-up
